subject.title: fix: recognize configured plugin dependencies by manifest id

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled PR be accepted after the contributor supplies inspectable runtime proof and the remaining exact-head checks complete?
rationale: The patch is narrowly scoped, but the protected label and absent inspectable live evidence make a human merge decision necessary.

options.title: Request runtime proof, then merge
options.body: Require a redacted terminal/log artifact that demonstrates the false warning disappears while a genuine missing dependency still warns, then merge if the remaining checks pass.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge on the focused regression and completed CI alone, accepting that the claimed real setup run is not independently inspectable.

recommendation.title: Request runtime proof, then merge
recommendation.body: Require a redacted terminal/log artifact that demonstrates the false warning disappears while a genuine missing dependency still warns, then merge if the remaining checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor authored the focused implementation and can provide the requested reproduction artifact; final merge authority remains with the protected-label reviewer.
